mock_data.title: All Kinds of Rage
mock_data.passage:
It seems that a great many of us are getting angrier, or at least that we are expressing our anger more. We seem to be flying into a rage all over the place and rage is now so common that the English language has acquired several expressions to describe particular forms of it.

The first of these rages to be named was road rage. This is used of drivers who are so enraged by other drivers or pedestrians that they let their anger get completely out of control. Often they get out of their cars and shout and make threatening gestures at the people who have annoyed them. Sometimes they are so beside themselves that they attack the people physically, and there have even been cases where drivers have gone berserk and killed people. It frequently does not take much to provoke drivers who are easily angered. Even overtaking them quite legally can enrage them.

Police are sometimes called to people's homes when rage gets out of control. In the worst cases, people who cannot control their tempers become guilty of domestic abuse and beat up their partners. This often leads to the break-up of the family and sometimes to the imprisonment of the violent partner.

The supermarket is another place where people get angry. People often get frustrated if they have to queue at the checkouts, sometimes becoming so furious that they are driven to trolley rage. Then they deliberately bang into others with their trolleys, sometimes causing injury.

Passengers in planes also sometimes fly off the handle. Known as air rage, this form of anger is usually directed at members of the cabin crew. It is common for passengers who lose their tempers in the air to have taken too much alcohol in the airport bars and to be spoiling for a fight when they board the aircraft. Their violence is dangerous in the air and they have to be restrained.

Try not to let any of this happen to you. Take a deep breath and keep your temper!
mock_data.passageB1:
Many people seem to be getting more angry, or at least showing their anger more often. It seems like people are becoming very angry in many situations. This kind of anger is now so common that we have new words to describe different types of it.

The first type of anger to get a name was road rage. This happens when drivers get very angry with other drivers or people walking. They lose control of their anger. They might get out of their cars and shout at the other people or make threatening movements. Sometimes, they get so angry that they attack people. There have even been times when drivers have become violent and hurt or killed people. It doesn't take much to make some drivers angry. Even if you pass them on the road in a normal way, it can make them angry.

The police are sometimes called to homes when anger becomes too much. In the worst cases, people who can't control their anger become guilty of hurting their partners. This is called domestic abuse. They might hit or hurt their partners. This can often cause the family to break up. Sometimes, the person who is violent goes to prison.

Supermarkets are another place where people get angry. People often get frustrated if they have to wait in line at the checkout. They might become so angry that they get trolley rage. This means they hit other people with their shopping trolleys on purpose. This can sometimes cause injuries.

People on planes also sometimes lose their temper. This is called air rage. This type of anger is usually directed at the people who work on the plane, the cabin crew. Often, passengers who get angry on a plane have drunk too much alcohol at the airport bars. They are looking for a fight when they get on the plane. Their violence is dangerous in the air, so they have to be restrained.

Try not to let any of this happen to you. Take a deep breath and control your anger!
mock_data.passageB2:
It appears that more and more people are experiencing anger, or at least, are expressing their frustration more openly. We seem to be losing our temper in various situations, and anger has become so prevalent that new terms have emerged to describe specific types of angry outbursts.

The first widely recognised form of this is road rage. This term refers to drivers who become so infuriated by the actions of other drivers or pedestrians that they completely lose control of their emotions. They might exit their vehicles to shout and make threatening gestures at those who have annoyed them. In extreme cases, they become so overwhelmed by rage that they physically attack others, and there have even been instances of drivers losing control and causing fatal accidents. It often doesn't take much to trigger drivers who are prone to anger; even a legal overtaking manoeuvre can provoke them.

Police intervention is sometimes required in domestic situations where anger escalates out of control. In the most serious cases, individuals who struggle to manage their temper may resort to domestic abuse, physically assaulting their partners. This can frequently lead to the breakdown of the family unit and, in some instances, the imprisonment of the abusive partner.

Supermarkets are another common setting for anger to surface. Customers often experience frustration when they have to queue at the checkouts, sometimes becoming so enraged that they are driven to trolley rage. This involves deliberately colliding with other shoppers using their shopping trolleys, potentially causing injuries.

Passengers on aeroplanes can also lose their cool. Known as air rage, this type of anger is typically directed at the cabin crew. It's common for passengers who become angry on board to have consumed excessive amounts of alcohol in airport bars and to be in an aggressive mood when they board the aircraft. Their violent behaviour is dangerous in flight, and they often need to be restrained.

Try to avoid allowing yourself to fall into these patterns. Take a moment to compose yourself and manage your anger effectively!
mock_data.passageC1:
A perceptible upswing in the frequency, or at least the outward manifestation, of anger seems to be pervading contemporary society. It would appear that incidents of uncontrolled fury are becoming increasingly commonplace, so much so that the English lexicon has expanded to encompass a range of expressions delineating specific iterations of this potent emotion.

Perhaps the first of these newly christened rages was 'road rage,' a term denoting the unbridled anger exhibited by drivers who, incensed by the actions of other motorists or pedestrians, allow their emotions to spiral entirely out of control. This often manifests in the form of vociferous outbursts and menacing gestures directed at the perceived offenders. In extreme cases, such individuals are so consumed by wrath that they resort to physical violence, with tragic instances of drivers succumbing to a berserk state and causing fatal harm. It frequently takes surprisingly little to ignite the fuse of these easily provoked individuals; even a perfectly legal overtaking manoeuvre can trigger their ire.

Law enforcement agencies are, regrettably, sometimes summoned to private residences to address instances where rage has escalated beyond manageable levels. In the most egregious of scenarios, individuals with poor impulse control may perpetrate acts of domestic abuse against their partners. This often precipitates the dissolution of the family unit and, in some instances, the incarceration of the offending party.

The seemingly innocuous environment of the supermarket can also prove to be a breeding ground for anger. The frustration engendered by protracted queues at checkout counters frequently boils over, leading to what has been termed 'trolley rage.' This involves the deliberate collision of shopping trolleys with other shoppers, sometimes resulting in physical injury. Such behaviour is indicative of a broader societal trend toward impatience and a lack of consideration for others.

Furthermore, passengers on aeroplanes are not immune to such outbursts. 'Air rage,' as it is known, is typically directed at members of the cabin crew. It is not uncommon for passengers who lose their composure mid-flight to have consumed excessive amounts of alcohol in airport bars, thereby predisposing themselves to belligerence upon boarding the aircraft. Such acts of aggression pose a significant safety risk in the confined environment of an aeroplane, necessitating the use of restraints.

Ultimately, the onus is on each individual to cultivate strategies for managing their anger. To that end, one might consider employing simple techniques such as taking a deep breath and exercising restraint in the face of provocation. Self-regulation is key to maintaining a harmonious and civil society.

mock_data.translation:
Ko'pchiligimiz tobora g'azabli bo'lib borayotganga o'xshaymiz, yoki hech bo'lmaganda g'azabimizni ko'proq ifodalayapmiz. Biz hamma joyda g'azabga berilayotgandek tuyulmaqda va g'azab endi shunchalik keng tarqalganki, ingliz tili uning turli shakllarini tasvirlash uchun bir nechta iboralarni egalladi.

Nomlanganlarning birinchisi yo'l g'azabi edi. Bu boshqa haydovchilar yoki piyodalardan shunchalik g'azablangan haydovchilar haqida qo'llaniladi, ular o'z g'azablarini butunlay nazoratdan chiqarib yuborishadi. Ko'pincha ular mashinalaridan tushib, baqirishadi va ularni bezovta qilgan odamlarga tahdid harakatlari qilishadi. Ba'zan ular shunchalik o'zlarini yo'qotadilarki, odamlarga jismoniy hujum qilishadi va hatto haydovchilar vahshiyona yo'qolgan va odamlarni o'ldirgan holatlar ham bo'lgan. Ko'pincha oson g'azablangan haydovchilarni provokatsiya qilish uchun ko'p narsa kerak emas. Hatto ularni qonuniy ravishda quvib o'tish ham ularni g'azablantirishi mumkin.

G'azab nazoratdan chiqib ketganda, ba'zan politsiya odamlarning uylariga chaqiriladi. Eng yomon hollarda, o'z xulqlarini nazorat qila olmaydigan odamlar oilaviy zo'ravonlikda aybdor bo'lishadi va sheriklariga kaltaklashadi. Bu ko'pincha oilaning parchalanishiga va ba'zan zo'ravon sherikni qamoqqa olishga olib keladi.

Supermarket odamlar g'azablanadigan yana bir joydir. Odamlar ko'pincha kassalarda navbatda turish kerak bo'lsa, asabiylashadilar, ba'zan shunchalik g'azablanishadiki, aravachalar g'azabiga beriladilar. Keyin ular ataylab boshqalarga o'z aravachchalari bilan uriladilar va ba'zan jarohat yetkazadilar.

Samolyotdagi yo'lovchilar ham ba'zan g'azabga berilishadi. Havo g'azabi deb nomlanuvchi bu g'azab shakli odatda ekipaj a'zolariga qaratiladi. Havoda asabini yo'qotgan yo'lovchilar uchun aeroport barlarida haddan tashqari alkogol ichishlari va samolyotga mingsalar janjal qilishga tayyor bo'lishlari odatiy holdir. Ularning zo'ravonligi havoda xavflidir va ular to'xtatilishi kerak.

Bularning hech biri sizga sodir bo'lishiga yo'l qo'ymang. Chuqur nafas oling va xotirjam bo'ling!

mock_data.translationB1:
Ko'pchilik odamlar tobora jahldor bo'lib qolayotgandek yoki hech bo'lmaganda o'z g'azablarini tez-tez namoyon qilayotgandek tuyuladi. Odamlar ko'p vaziyatlarda juda jahli chiqayotgandek. G'azabning bu turi hozir juda keng tarqalganki, bizda uning turli xil turlarini tasvirlash uchun yangi so'zlar bor.

Nom olgan g'azabning birinchi turi yo'l g'azabi edi. Bu haydovchilar boshqa haydovchilarga yoki piyodalarga juda g'azablanganida sodir bo'ladi. Ular o'z g'azabini nazorat qila olmaydilar. Ular mashinalaridan chiqib, boshqa odamlarga baqirishlari yoki tahdidli harakatlar qilishlari mumkin. Ba'zan ular shunchalik g'azablanadilarki, odamlarga hujum qilishadi. Hatto haydovchilar zo'ravonlik qilib, odamlarga zarar yetkazgan yoki o'ldirgan holatlar ham bo'lgan. Ba'zi haydovchilarni g'azablantirish uchun ko'p narsa kerak emas. Hatto ularning yonidan oddiygina tarzda o'tib ketsangiz ham, bu ularni g'azablantirishi mumkin.

G'azab haddan tashqari kuchayganda, politsiya ba'zan uylarga chaqiriladi. Eng yomon holatlarda, o'z g'azabini nazorat qila olmaydigan odamlar o'z sheriklariga zarar yetkazishda aybdor bo'lib qolishadi. Bu oilaviy zo'ravonlik deb ataladi. Ular sheriklarini urishi yoki jarohatlashi mumkin. Bu ko'pincha oilaning buzilishiga olib kelishi mumkin. Ba'zan, zo'ravon odam qamoqqa tushadi.

Supermarketlar ham odamlar g'azablanadigan yana bir joy. Odamlar ko'pincha kassada navbatda turishga to'g'ri kelganda tushkunlikka tushishadi. Ular shunchalik g'azablanishlari mumkinki, arava g'azabi paydo bo'lishi mumkin. Bu ularning boshqa odamlarni xarid qilish aravachalari bilan ataylab urishini anglatadi. Bu ba'zan jarohatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.

Samolyotlardagi odamlar ham ba'zan o'zlarini tuta olmay qolishadi. Bu havo g'azabi deb ataladi. G'azabning bu turi odatda samolyotda ishlaydigan odamlarga, ekipaj a'zolariga qaratilgan. Ko'pincha, samolyotda g'azablangan yo'lovchilar aeroport barlarida juda ko'p spirtli ichimlik ichishgan bo'ladi. Ular samolyotga chiqqanlarida urush qidirishadi. Ularning zo'ravonligi havoda xavfli, shuning uchun ularni cheklashga to'g'ri keladi.

Buning hech biri siz bilan sodir bo'lishiga yo'l qo'ymang. Chuqur nafas oling va g'azabingizni nazorat qiling!
